comment: pager.c look lists under a UTF-8 symset: wintty.c tty_putmixed() calls utf8map.c mixed_to_utf8(), which writes a glyph's gm.u->utf8str bytes into the line. process_text_window() prints them a byte at a time, each advancing the cursor, and recorder patch 006's nomux_putch() ignores every byte with its high bit set, so Enhanced1's two-byte engraving symbol U+03BE leaves two blank cells and shifts the rest of the row by one.
